mentions.name: Gecko mega-paradise vivarium
mentions.description: A DIY automated vivarium for a pet gecko, designed to replicate the gecko's native New Caledonian environment. Plans include weather systems, as many sensors as possible, cameras, and a jury-rigged toilet setup running water from a reservoir to a rain system to recreate the island habitat as closely as possible.
mentions.problem: Replicating the gecko's native New Caledonia environment is difficult because most of the island's plants are found nowhere else, though a close approximation is possible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently found out my wife wants a gecko, so I’ve begun planning for a mega-paradise. I want weather systems, every sensor I could possibly ram in there, cameras, and more. Planning to jury rig a toilet setup to run water from the reservoir to the rain system.
